name: show_live_notes
description: Open Amy's Live Notes only when the visitor explicitly asks to see notes, captured details, what Amy heard, or what Amy wrote down. Call silently with exactly an empty object. Do not call during a farewell or use the tool to carry spoken text. This is a current-session working aid, not a CRM record or completed assessment.

name: show_session_brief
description: Rebuild and open Amy's Live Brief from the latest current-session turns whenever the visitor explicitly asks for the Live Brief, requests an update, refresh, or regeneration, or says the displayed brief is stale. A named Live Brief request always uses this tool, never show_live_notes. Wait for the tool result and confirm only that the working view is open; do not claim specific tracks are visible unless they were stated in the current conversation. Call silently with exactly an empty object.

name: show_solution_roadmap
description: Rebuild and open Amy's Roadmap from the latest current-session turns whenever the visitor asks for a roadmap, phased plan, implementation path, rollout sequence, asks to see what a plan would look like, requests an update, refresh, or regeneration, or says the displayed roadmap is stale. Call this before speaking a step-by-step plan. The topic must summarize all confirmed current-session tracks and must not contain spoken reply text. Wait for the tool result and confirm only that the working view is open; do not claim specific tracks are visible unless they were stated in the current conversation. Do not call during a farewell. The roadmap is illustrative and is not an approved design, quote, commitment, or completed assessment.

topic.description: A compact summary of the confirmed outcome, environment, workload, timing, constraints, and continuity requirements relevant to the requested roadmap. Omit uncertain details.

name: show_visual_brief
description: Open/rebuild Amy's Visual Brief for a visual or update, refresh, rebuild, or regenerate request. For updates, call this tool again; speech is not an update. Require a meaningful business objective plus at least two grounding signals; otherwise ask one brief clarification. contentChanged, appliedChanges, and visibleFacts are the only source of truth. Confirm receipt facts in one short sentence. If contentChanged is false or the requested delta is absent from both appliedChanges and visibleFacts, say the requested change did not land and ask one precise clarification. Label planning assumptions explicitly; keep concurrent timelines separate and named; preserve merger or added-site/system scope expansion, never a generic guardrail. In healthcare or EHR conversations, never infer a root cause, internal workflow stage, field/event, export, method, chart design, permission, or compliance. Call silently with {}. No farewell calls. Working view only; not an approved design or production plan.

name: show_solution_catalog
description: Open Amy's directional solution-category catalog when the visitor explicitly asks to see a catalog, product categories, device categories, or solution categories. This client display does not return live inventory, pricing, availability, lead time, or contract eligibility. Include a concise query based only on the visitor's stated interest. Call silently and never during a farewell.

query.description: A concise product or solution category request using confirmed current-session language. Do not include contact information.
